hotel_name: Hotel O By Oyo Kanak Palace

negative_snippets: The booking.com app and this hotel are running a scam together. When I booked a room for two nights, the price showed INR 1300, but when I reached the hotel they said that booking amount is different from actual amount and asked for 2600 which is double the booking price. Finally, when I said not to stay they charged 700 for cancellation and then finally I had to stay for one night for 1000 because I had no choice. If you visit Delhi, never book stay from any app like Booking.com, Agoda, or Oyo. Just visit the hotel and ask for actual price.
Beware of this hotel. A camera was found in the bulb holder. This is mostly booked by unmarried couples on hourly basis. Families stay away. Room condition is pathetic.

They denied the complimentary check in between 10-12 (as per OYO policy), offered us to cancel the oyo booking and book offline for early check in. Then when we entered the reception at noon,(12 p.m. check-in time) the manager denied check in and the app now showed us to pay 650 extra because the number of guests had been altered by the manager from 2 people to 3 (excluding the 720 paid the day before) even though it was prepaid and booked for 2. I talked to 5-6 customer care executives and my issue weren't resolved. Then a guy who was supposedly the area manager told us to wait 30 minutes. At 12:50 the manager said he will give check in but during the calls from OYO he laughed and said "customer bhi waisa hi pandey ji bhi waisa hi" now I don't know about pandey ji but I couldn't tolerate it after wasting hours on them. I had to leave the place without refund. OYO said they can't refund me because I was offered check in. But they didn't take into account that it was already 1 hour since I say at the reception. Worst place. Worst people. Don't go to ruin their dignity. Also the place looked like it was made in a minute. *No help from OYO service, none from the staff* *rude manager laughed at me for not paying merely 600 more*
